correctness.rationale: Each block i has d_i wrong symbols, which must be exported and re-imported in equal number; therefore d_i<=min(a_i,m-d_i). Conversely choose d_i within min(a_i,floor(m/2)) summing to m and rotate the grouped length-m mismatch color word by floor(m/2): no identical color survives because each monochromatic cyclic block length is <=floor(m/2). This preserves counts and gives exactly m mismatches. Two blocks force parity; for k>=3 the cap sum is enough for every 2<=m<=min(n,2(n-a_max)). Independently enumerated exact permutation DP supports for all 255 ordered positive compositions with 1<=n<=8 and matched the general criterion; inspected supplied broader n<=11 dynamic-programming checker (not treated as proof).
residual_risks: The independent finite DP covers n<=8 and does not prove the general result.

evidence: Stark bounds law of W asymptotically; zero-diagonal flow feasibility can imply necessary cap inequality but not the closed full spectrum without specialization.
